unverified: 3rd Street (A1A), Beach Boulevard, and Atlantic Boulevard change speed along the coast. An untagged piece of those roads is the class default until a sign is read.
Neptune Beach Ordinance 2020-17 created a golf cart article. The adopted street list was not read, so plain golf carts are not shown on those streets.

Untagged residential, living street, service, unclassified, and tertiary roads are assumed 25 mph. A tertiary road posted above the cap would show as legal until a sign or a DOT speed is added. Those roads are listed for a person to check. A posted sign still wins.

enforcement.note: Plain golf carts stay red because Florida requires a designated street list and the adopted Neptune Beach street text was not in hand (the city PDF returned 404). Atlantic Beach Ordinance 75-25-29 Sec. 21-107(i) says a registered low-speed vehicle may operate only on city roadways. No beach-city list banning LSVs from a named road was applied. Jacksonville city proper is outside this box.
